purpose: Separate Memory Atlas coverage from Evidence-final research maturity so campaign progress is not overstated by a sealed blind map and is not reduced to one misleading completion percentage.

generated_from.snapshot_note: analysis_tree_sha is the pre-index-refresh analysis snapshot that already includes the latest curated assessment and the MS-0120 next-lead repair; the index file itself changes the directory tree and therefore cannot self-reference its own post-write tree SHA.

atlas_coverage.important_boundary: Atlas saturation means major remembered mechanism blocks were reviewed at bounded depth. It does not mean all 131 leads have source-grounded Evidence, typed projections or resolved Outcomes, and it is not a claim of comprehensive semiconductor-memory history.

evidence_final_inventory.important_boundary: One executed packet can ground multiple Memory Leads and one Memory Lead can require multiple packets. Receipt count must not be divided by 131 to manufacture a lead-completion percentage.

maturity_by_layer.interpretation: Evidence/Reality/Judgment/Outcome, known-time/valid-time, no-lookahead, materialized-source execution, semantic catalog and continuity are functioning proving-ground infrastructure rather than the dominant remaining bottleneck.
The map of major mechanisms and periods is broad enough to drive targeted research without repeated blind brainstorming.

High-value trunks across HBM, supplier cuts, DDR5/device revisions, enterprise SSD/storage, cross-industry demand, export controls, the 2017 upcycle, the 2022 inventory-amplification turn, the 2024 conventional-versus-AI recovery decomposition and HBM bottleneck-stage decomposition now have executed packets, but the 131-lead atlas is far from exhaustively grounded.

Several end-to-end trajectories prove the model, but typed projection is intentionally narrower than Evidence coverage because unsupported causal synthesis and incomparable Outcomes are left unresolved.

current_known_thin_areas: customer/channel inventory beyond the now-grounded 2022 de-stocking turn, especially module/distribution and spot-channel layers
module/distribution spot-channel price and inventory evidence

HBM package/test and advanced-packaging capacity now have first grounded stage evidence, but comparable supplier-specific packaging yield/throughput, equipment, bonder and substrate constraints remain thin
comparable realized Outcomes for some market forecasts, including the unresolved full-year enterprise-SSD/QLC absolute-volume gap
quantified comparable product-line attribution between conventional DRAM/NAND recovery and HBM/AI or enterprise-SSD mix; current research supports decomposition but not causal shares
named-program evidence that identifies which HBM constraint stage was actually binding at a given supplier/customer/platform vintage

progress_interpretation.plain_language: The industry map is largely built and the research engine works. The campaign is now in the expensive middle phase: converting the most important remembered leads into claim-scoped, time-correct Evidence and then selectively into Reality/Judgment/Outcome. A rough human estimate around forty percent Evidence-final maturity remains directionally reasonable, but this index should be used instead of treating that estimate as a metric.
progress_interpretation.next_value_step: Continue the sealed high-importance counterfactual pass at MS-0122: test whether DRAM and NAND truly share one cycle or only appear synchronized because common macro demand and supplier capex overlap while product-specific concentration, elasticity, technology cadence and end-market mix create lead/lag. Reuse the grounded 2017 upcycle, 2022 inventory-amplification and 2024 recovery packets rather than repeating generic cycle narratives.
